title: Consistent Video-to-Video Translation via Explicit Correspondences
abstract: arXiv:2611.17298v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive video-to-video applications require real-time generation while maintaining long-range temporal consistency. However, recent methods achieve speed by restricting attention to a fixed-length causal window. This limits long-range consistency whenever relevant history falls outside the context window. To address this limitation, we introduce vid2vid-long, a correspondence-based approach grounded in a simple observation. Video-to-video translation provides an explicit cross-frame reference: the regions that match in the input video should match in the output video too. translated_title: 通过显式对应关系实现一致的视觉到视频翻译
translated_abstract: 交互式视频到视频应用需要在保持长程时间一致性的同时实现实时生成。然而，近期的方法通过将注意力限制在固定长度的因果窗口内来提升速度，当相关历史信息落在上下文窗口之外时，这种做法限制了长程一致性。为解决这一局限，我们提出了 vid2vid-long，一种基于简单观察的对应关系方法：视频到视频翻译提供了显式的跨帧参考，即输入视频中相互匹配的区域在输出视频中也应当匹配。具体而言，我们在输入视频中计算块级对应关系，据此引导检索先前生成的对应区域的输出，并通过对应交叉注意力将这些图像块作为模型的条件。我们的实验表明，vid2vid-long 在多个近期视频模型上持续提升长程时间一致性，同时保持实时性能。
tldr: 该论文提出 vid2vid-long，通过在输入视频中计算块级对应关系，并借助对应交叉注意力检索先前生成的输出，突破了固定因果窗口的限制，在实时视频到视频翻译中实现了长程时间一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces vid2vid-long, which computes patch-level correspondences in the input video and conditions the model on retrieved previously generated outputs via correspondence cross-attention, breaking the fixed causal-window limitation to achieve long-range temporal consistency in real-time video-to-video translation.
